# AI 参与说明 / AI Disclosure

## 中文

### AI 参与范围

本项目**大部分代码由 AI 编程助手生成**，部分测试与文档也有 AI 辅助完成。人类维护者负责需求定义、调试、测试设计与验收、发布及后续维护，并对最终代码质量负责。

AI 生成的内容可能存在错误、遗漏或不适用于特定环境的实现。欢迎通过 issue 或 pull request 反馈问题、提出改进；维护者将结合项目实际情况进行评估和处理。

### 责任与许可

- 本项目依据 **MIT License** 发布，不提供超出许可证约定范围的任何保证。
- AI 工具不是本项目的作者、版权持有者或责任主体；人类维护者以项目发布者身份承担维护责任。
- 本文仅用于说明项目的开发过程，不构成法律意见。

## English

### Scope of AI Involvement

**Most of the code in this project was generated by AI coding assistants**, and some tests and documentation were also created with AI assistance. The human maintainer is responsible for defining requirements, debugging, designing and validating tests, managing releases, and ongoing maintenance, as well as for the quality of the final code.

AI-generated content may contain errors, omissions, or implementations that are unsuitable for particular environments. Issues and pull requests are welcome; the maintainer will evaluate and address them in the context of the project.

### Responsibility and License

- This project is released under the **MIT License**, with no warranties beyond those provided by the license.
- AI tools are not authors, copyright holders, or responsible parties for this project; the human maintainer accepts maintenance responsibility as the project publisher.
- This document describes the development process only and does not constitute legal advice.
